in_sanskrit.name: गंगावर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ganga is the goddess of the Ganges river in Hindu mythology. A var is a protector or guardian. This name means 'Ganga's protector'.

in_hindi.name: गंगावर
in_hindi.long_meaning: गंगा पर्वत की रक्षा करने वाला नाम है।

in_telugu.name: గంగావర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: గంగా నది పర్వత కు రక్షించే వర్ అయిన పేరు.

in_marathi.name: Gangavar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gangavar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ganga' (the holy river Ganges) and 'vara' (protection), this name signifies the divine protection offered by the river.

in_bengali.name: Gangavar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ganga's protection
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gangavar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ganga' (the holy river Ganges) and 'vara' (protection), this name signifies the divine protection offered by the river.
